## CONFIRMED FINDINGS [LOCKED] [LOCKED]

### NFRC Performance Ratings (Standard Low-E Glass with Argon)

**U-Factor:** For the U-factor on the Ply Gem 800 Series double hung to vary from .36 to .29

**SHGC:** Expect the SHGC to vary pretty significantly, anywhere from .40 to .26

**Air Infiltration:** The Pro model doesn't have all that impressive an air infiltration rating, which will vary from .11 to .15

### AAMA Certification and Structural Performance

**Design Pressure Rating:** 
Our products meet a Design Press (DP) rating of 35 (double hung) to as high as DP70 casement (gateway size of 24″ x 60″)


**AAMA Standards:** 
Contractor windows built by Simonton are AAMA Gold certified, passing stringent tests for thermal performance as well as air leakage, water infiltration and wind pressure
 (from supplemental research file)

### Energy Star Certification

**Energy Star Status:** 
many configurations meet ENERGY STAR® standards


**Tax Credit Eligibility:** Select Ply Gem windows can be ordered to meet ENERGY STAR Most Efficient criteria, with Cornerstone Building Brands' Window & Door Qualified Manufacturer (QM) Code C3N5 for federal tax credit purposes

### Construction Features

**Spacer System:** 
Values reflect the performance of units tested with the following configuration: 7/8″ IGU (3/4″ IGU Double Hung), 3mm glass, warm edge spacer and no grilles


**Frame Construction:** For added insulation, High Performance HP glass packages combine Low-E coatings with Argon gas, which is denser than air and sealed inside the insulating glass unit

**Glass Technology:** ProSolar® Low E glass with Argon gas helps reduce heating and cooling costs (from supplemental research file)

### Warranty Coverage - Updated 2025

**Pro Series Warranty:** 
Ply Gem Pro Series windows come with a limited lifetime warranty


**Warranty Transferability:** 
coverage will be twenty (20) years for material and five (5) years for labor to the subsequent property owner/consumer
 (from supplemental research file)

**Labor Coverage Limitations:** 
Their labor warranty is weak — just one year on select window lines, and none at all on others. Compared to brands that back their installation with strong guarantees, this can be a dealbreaker


### Pricing Range

**Window Cost:** 
The entry-level vinyl windows, such as the Pro Series 200, typically start around $150 to $200 per window unit, uninstalled

## RED FINDINGS [LOCKED] [LOCKED] - DOCUMENTED ISSUES

### Active Class Action Litigation (2025)

**Current Federal Case:** 
Ply Gem Specialty Products LLC and its parent company, Cornerstone Building Brands Inc., are facing a class action lawsuit over allegedly defective windows. In a complaint filed June 26, 2025, plaintiffs William G. Jameson and Bill Lane, on behalf of themselves and others, allege that the Ply Gem brand windows provided for homes in a residential neighborhood of Lancaster County, South Carolina, lack essential components, like desiccants, and feature faulty seals and weep systems


**Specific Product Claims:** 
Ply Gem Specialty Products and Cornerstone Building Brands face a proposed class action lawsuit that alleges the companies' Builder 1100 series vinyl windows are defective in that they are unable to prevent moisture intrusion


**Federal Court Status:** 
The transition to federal court occurred when Ply Gem and Cornerstone filed a Notice of Removal on June 26, 2025. The case was originally filed in state court, but has been removed to federal court, due to diversity of citizenship and the amount in controversy


**Alleged Damages:** 
the windows' failure to keep out moisture can cause visible fogging, reduced visibility, water accumulation and water transfer to window sills, frames and surrounding walls, posing the risk of mold, wood rot and other property damage

### Design Pressure Rating Verification (2025)
**Confirmed DP Rating:** 
Each window is tested to ensure it meets and/or exceeds the air, water, and structure standards set by AAMA/WDMA 101/I.S.2. Ply Gem's windows have a DP rating of 35 for double hung windows up to as high as 70 for certain casement windows

### Pro Series Positioning Clarification (2025)
**Market Position:** 
My research has led me to the conclusion that Ply Gem has 3 levels of window quality—Builder/contractor grade, Ply Gem Pro series and Ply Gem Premium series quality windows. Most sources seem to indicate that the Ply Gem 1500 series window is the best of the builder/contractor grade windows. It is not at the same quality level as the mid grade Ply Gem Pro, or Ply Gem Premium series
